description:
## What it does

Two x402-paid inspection services for AI agents. x402 Preflight audits a public HTTPS endpoint's unpaid x402 challenge. HTTP Inspect returns structured HTTP response metadata, redirect information, a bounded body preview, and x402 signals.

## Best for

- Checking whether a paid API exposes a usable x402 challenge before integration.
- Inspecting public HTTPS endpoints from an agent workflow.
- Collecting machine-readable status and response metadata without API keys.

endpoints.description: Probe a public HTTPS endpoint and report whether its unpaid response exposes a valid x402 challenge.
Inspect a public HTTPS endpoint and return status, redirect and content metadata, bounded body preview, and x402 signals.

zh-CN.description:
## 功能

提供两个通过 x402 付费的 Agent 检查服务。x402 Preflight 用于审计公网 HTTPS 端点的未付费 x402 challenge；HTTP Inspect 返回结构化 HTTP 状态、重定向、有限正文预览及 x402 信号。

## 适用场景

- 集成付费 API 前检查 x402 challenge。
- Agent 工作流中检查公网 HTTPS 端点。
- 无需 API Key 获取机器可读的响应信息。
